faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a1: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and bank transfers through Stripe. Enterprise clients can arrange invoicing.
faq.q2: Can I change my plan later?
faq.a2: Yes, you can upgrade your plan at any time. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.
faq.a3: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for annual plans. Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time.
faq.q4: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.a4: Our Basic tier is free forever with 5 amendments per month. You can try Professional features with a 14-day trial.
faq.a5: Enterprise pricing is customised based on team size, feature requirements, and usage volume. Contact us for a tailored quote.
faq.q6: What happens if I exceed my amendment limit?
faq.a6: Basic tier users are limited to 5 amendments per month. To create more, upgrade to Professional for unlimited amendments.

story.title: From research question to policy action in minutes, not weeks
story.intro: Brubru’s AI understands EU institutional processes, legislative procedures, and policy context. Here’s how professionals use it every day.
story.step1Content: Type any EU policy question in natural language. Brubru’s AI draws on a knowledge base of 50,000+ EU laws, EP committee reports, Commission proposals, EPRS briefings, and 11 Beresol open reports covering topics from AI Act implementation to CBAM compliance.
story.step2Content: Set up RSS feeds from the European Parliament, Council, Commission, EUR-Lex, and more. Track specific legislative files through the Legislative Train, monitor EP committee work, and get alerts on public consultations with upcoming deadlines.
story.step3Content: Load any EU regulation or directive from EUR-Lex, select the article or recital you want to amend, and let the AI suggest changes. Export in Akoma Ntoso XML, PDF, or Word format following official EP formatting guidelines.
story.step4Content: Produce AI-powered position papers, MEP briefing notes, and talking points tailored to your policy area. Run compliance gap analysis with EU Law Comply to check how new legislation affects your organisation or sector.

about.title: Built in Brussels, for the EU bubble
about.text1: Brubru is developed by Beresol, a Brussels-based public affairs technology company. We combine deep understanding of EU institutional processes with cutting-edge AI to create tools that actually work for policy professionals.
about.text2: Our mission is to democratise access to EU policy intelligence. Whether you’re a lobbyist tracking legislative files, an NGO drafting amendments, or a trade association monitoring consultations — Brubru gives you the same analytical power as the largest firms in town.
about.gdprDesc: EU-hosted infrastructure. Your data stays in Europe.
about.multilingualDesc: AI understands and responds in all EU languages.
about.multiAiDesc: Mistral, Claude, GPT-4, and Gemini for reliability.
about.lawsDesc: Comprehensive knowledge base of EU legislation.
about.founderBio: Brussels-based public affairs professional and technologist. Victor founded Beresol to bridge the gap between EU policy expertise and modern AI technology, making institutional knowledge accessible to everyone in the EU bubble.
